clean_description: Rubicon explores the transition of Rome from a republic to an empire during the tumultuous period of 49 B.C. It focuses on key historical figures such as Julius Caesar, Cicero, and Cleopatra, illustrating the complexities of Roman society through civil war, political intrigue, and personal rivalries. Tom Holland combines engaging narrative with thorough scholarship to present a vivid portrait of this pivotal era in Roman history.
themes: political power, civil war, historical transformation
setting: ancient Rome during the late Republic
